name: VOST Portugal
summary: A volunteers' association that relayed IPMA's move of Lisbon's red rain warning in public 57 minutes after IPMA sent it.
label: ours

edges.label: evidence
edges.says: IPMA's move of Lisbon's red rain to 09:00 (sent 21:23) was relayed in public by VOST Portugal, a volunteers' association, 57 minutes after IPMA sent it; no press title we read had it by 00:15 (row s-1111T0015 stands for the press)
